metaDescription: Order custom made in USA blankets for your team or event. High-quality, American-made. Get a quote today.
introHtml: When you need promotional blankets that reflect a commitment to American manufacturing, custom made in USA blankets deliver. The Made*Here New York Basketweave Cotton Blanket, for example, combines domestic production with a classic, durable weave that holds up to repeated use. Perfect for employee gifts, trade show giveaways, or safety rewards, these blankets offer a tangible way to show your values. Choose from embroidery or screen printing for your logo or message.
